functions.behavior: Call voice VM setter, then billing VM setter, then GetEnv with JNI 1.4. Return 0x10004 on zero status, -1 otherwise. Preserve the persistent environment output slot, including writes on failure.

functions.cases: Eight statuses (0, 1, 2, -1, -2, -3, INT32_MIN, INT32_MAX), each with and without an environment write; exact event ordering and VM/version arguments; stale output preservation; ignored VM-setter results poisoned in original emulation

functions.cases: Known, all-byte, deterministic random and boundary-length buffers through 65535 bytes, four original pointer alignments, null/empty, input preservation; original ARM compared with compiled source and Python zlib
